cues: The iron three over iron two couple, plus zero point seven seven volts, lies above copper, so iron three ions oxidise copper.
Dilute hydrochloric and sulphuric acids cannot, since copper is below hydrogen, and zinc ions are far too weak an oxidant.
text: C, iron three chloride. The iron three over iron two couple, plus zero point seven seven volts, lies above copper, so iron three ions oxidise copper. Dilute hydrochloric and sulphuric acids cannot, since copper is below hydrogen, and zinc ions are far too weak an oxidant.
